acquisition/passive.screenDescription: Only after you explicitly enable the service and grant camera and notification permissions does it wait for a new device-unlock opportunity. When the interval allows an attempt, it starts a front-camera analysis-only session, observes face readiness, then performs the formal heart-rate estimate; it creates no preview, records no audio, and uploads nothing automatically.
acquisition/passive.privacyNotice: The camera stays closed while waiting. New RPPG triads are saved in the app-specific external directory under Android/data; access by ordinary apps is restricted, and uninstalling the app removes these files. Existing internal results and historical videos stay in place. Files are not uploaded or cleaned up automatically; signal conclusions are not medical diagnoses.

acquisition/passive.guidanceMessage: Some manufacturers restrict background activity. On HONOR devices, open Settings > Apps > This app > Battery usage > App launch, turn off “Manage automatically”, and enable “Allow background activity”. Do not enable “Auto-launch” or “Secondary launch”. These are manufacturer settings, not Android runtime permissions, and the app cannot inspect or grant them. After changing this setting, return to the app, tap Enable again, and choose “Done / not applicable, continue”. If your device has no such setting, continue directly. Manufacturer labels and paths can vary.
